title: 第一卷 第9章 闫耀宗，你特娘的胆肥了是吧？
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

另一边，村委会，闫耀宗把各种药品跟消毒水，都分给了村民们。

村民们一个个都夸张闫耀宗有本事，就连镇长都认识。

闫耀宗凭借着上辈子在深广打拼练出来的口才，把叔伯婶姨们，哄得那叫一个乐得合不拢嘴。

“呼！”

把村民都送出村委会办公室，闫耀宗长松一口气，扭头看向站在那里的老村长。

老村长满脸惊奇地上下打量着闫耀宗，在他的记忆中，闫耀宗沉默寡言，性子懦弱，可刚刚……简直就好似变了个人。

“耀宗啊。你去上叶村、洪家村送药，他们肯定会”

“叔，你就放心吧。我闫耀宗不是那种人！”闫耀宗咧嘴笑道。

“那行吧。我就先回去了！”老村长道。

“叔，我送送你！”

“不用不用！”老村长摆摆手。

老村长走到门口处，穿上蓑衣，戴上雨帽，大步离去。

“耀宗，你是真厉害！”闫大忠咧着嘴，跑到闫耀宗旁边，朝着他，竖起大拇指，道：“耀宗，你认识了镇长，以后肯定能去镇里的工厂上班。到时候，你能不能拉兄弟一把？”

“看情况吧！”闫耀宗笑了笑，扭头看向闫大忠跟闫振东，道：“咱们先把药分一分，然后去上叶村跟洪家村！”

“行！”

“耀宗，你说，政府啥时候能把粮食送过来？”

暴雨哗啦啦地下着。

三四米外的景物，都看不真切。

上叶村。

大多数村民都满脸无聊的坐在屋檐下，表情木纳，眼神呆滞地看着不断落下的雨滴。

村里的狗汪汪汪地叫了起来。

叶大柄眯着眼，看着远处深一步、浅一步走来的三道身影。

“柄叔，看雨呢！”

闫大忠笑着跟叶大柄打了一声招呼。

叶大柄嘴角一抽，小兔崽子，你不会说话，就别说话，没人当你是哑巴。

什么叫‘看雨呢’？

content_en:
Page (1/3)

On the other side, at the village committee, Yan Yaozong distributed various medicines and disinfectants to the villagers.

Every villager exaggerated Yan Yaozong's ability, and even the mayor knew him.

Yan Yaozong relied on the eloquence he had honed while working hard in Shenzhen and Guangzhou in his previous life, and coaxed his uncles and aunts to the point where they were screaming with joy.

"Phew!"

After sending all the villagers out of the village committee office, Yan Yaozong breathed a sigh of relief and turned to look at the old village chief standing there.

The old village chief looked up and down at Yan Yaozong with surprise on his face. In his memory, Yan Yaozong was taciturn and cowardly, but just now... he seemed to be a different person.

"Yao Zong. If you go to Shangye Village and Hongjia Village to deliver medicine, they will definitely do it."

"Uncle, don't worry. I, Yan Yaozong, am not that kind of person!" Yan Yaozong grinned.

"That's okay. I'll go back first!" said the old village chief.

"Uncle, I'll give it to you!"

"No, no, no!" The old village chief waved his hand.

The old village chief walked to the door, put on his raincoat and rain hat, and strode away.

"Yao Zhong, you are so awesome!" Yan Dazhong grinned, ran to Yan Yaozong's side, gave him a thumbs up, and said, "Yao Zong, if you get to know the mayor, you will definitely be able to work in the town's factory in the future. When the time comes, can you help your brother?"

"It depends on the situation!" Yan Yaozong smiled, turned to look at Yan Dazhong and Yan Zhendong, and said: "Let's divide the medicine first, and then go to Shangye Village and Hongjiacun!"

"Okay!"

"Yao Zong, tell me, when will the government deliver the food?"

The rain was falling heavily.

The scenery three or four meters away is not clear.

Shangye Village.

Most of the villagers were sitting under the eaves with bored expressions and dull eyes looking at the falling raindrops.

The village dog started barking.

Ye Daying squinted his eyes and looked at the three figures walking towards each other in the distance.

"Uncle Bing, look at the rain!"

Yan Dazhong smiled and said hello to Ye Dadian.

The corner of Ye Dadian's mouth twitched, little bastard, if you can't speak, just stop talking, no one will think you are mute.

What does ‘watching the rain’ mean?
